title: About and Updates
summary: Information about Preview for Linux and Windows, release versioning, developer credits, and update checking.

sections.heading: Application Overview
sections.text: Preview for Linux and Windows provides an authentic macOS document viewing and markup experience powered by PyQt6, PyMuPDF, and Pillow.

sections.heading: Developer and Attribution
sections.text: Developed by Shivam Prasad and powered by TriviLabs.in.

sections.heading: Checking for Updates
sections.text: Preview checks for new releases on startup once every 24 hours. You can also run a manual update check at any time.

steps: Select Help > Check for Updates... or Apple Menu > Check for Updates...
Review new release notes and improvements in the update window.
Click Download & Install to automatically download the package.
note: Select Help > About Document Viewer to review build numbers and license details.
